    def __init__(self, capacity: int, refill_rate: float, clock=None):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.refill_rate = refill_rate
        self.tokens = capacity
        self.last_checked_time = clock() if clock else time.time()

        current_time = self.clock() if self.clock else time.time()
        elapsed_seconds = current_time - self.last_checked_time
        self.tokens += elapsed_seconds * self.refill_rate
        self.tokens = min(self.tokens, self.capacity)

            return True
